slowLinkExtended.title: Test extended
slowLinkExtended.download: Download had no steady window at its minimum duration, so it was extended up to its maximum.
slowLinkExtended.upload: Upload had no steady window at its minimum duration, so it was extended up to its maximum.
slowLinkExtended.both: Neither download nor upload had a steady window at its minimum duration, so both were extended up to their maximum.

dataCapReached.title: Data cap reached
dataCapReached.download: Download stopped at the data cap; what it measured until then is kept.
dataCapReached.upload: Upload stopped at the data cap; what it measured until then is kept.

dataUsed.title: Data used: {data}
dataUsed.body: This run has passed {data}. The next notice appears at {next}.

streamLimit.title: Server stream limit — {n} stream | Server stream limit — {n} streams
streamLimit.download: The server refused more parallel streams, so download ran with at most {n}.
streamLimit.upload: The server refused more parallel streams, so upload ran with at most {n}.

rate.download: The server's request rate limit refused some download requests. The download waited as the server asked and continued, so its number may be below what the link can carry.
rate.upload: The server's request rate limit refused some upload requests. The upload waited as the server asked and continued, so its number may be below what the link can carry.

tableFull.download: The server was tracking too many clients and refused some download requests. The download waited as the server asked and continued, so its number may be below what the link can carry.
tableFull.upload: The server was tracking too many clients and refused some upload requests. The upload waited as the server asked and continued, so its number may be below what the link can carry.

notRetried.download: Some download requests were refused. The download did not retry those requests before the phase ended.
notRetried.upload: Some upload requests were refused. The upload did not retry those requests before the phase ended.

insufficientData.title: {direction}: insufficient data
insufficientData.download: Download had no confirmed steady window long enough for a number.
insufficientData.upload: Upload had no confirmed steady window long enough for a number.
insufficientData.downloadMax: Download reached its {max} maximum without a confirmed steady window long enough for a number.
insufficientData.uploadMax: Upload reached its {max} maximum without a confirmed steady window long enough for a number.
insufficientData.downloadCap: Download stopped at the data cap before a confirmed steady window long enough for a number.
insufficientData.uploadCap: Upload stopped at the data cap before a confirmed steady window long enough for a number.

offer.standard: Standard allows up to 20 s for download and 25 s for upload.
offer.extended: Extended allows up to 40 s per direction.

urlParameterIgnored.title: URL parameter ignored
urlParameterIgnored.body: {parameter}={value} ignored, allowed {allowed}. {stays}; the other parameters from the link were applied.

stays.durationsSplit: Durations stay on {download} for download and {upload} for upload
stays.noRunLength: The run has no run length
stays.label: The label stays on the suggested one
stays.default: The setting stays on its default

stoppedEarly.title: Test cancelled during {phase}
stoppedEarly.partialUpload: Partial — stopped early · upload based on a {covered} steady window
stoppedEarly.noProbe: The WebSocket closed and its reopening was never answered, so no latency probe could be sent during the {phase}.
stoppedEarly.downloadNone: Download stopped before a 3 s steady window, so it has no value.
stoppedEarly.downloadPartial: Download has a {covered} steady window, enough for a partial value.
stoppedEarly.uploadNone: Upload stopped at {at}, before a 3 s confirmed steady window, so it has no value.
stoppedEarly.uploadNoneWarmup: Upload stopped at {at}, before a 3 s confirmed steady window (still in warm-up), so it has no value.
stoppedEarly.uploadNoneUntimed: Upload stopped before a 3 s confirmed steady window, so it has no value.
stoppedEarly.uploadNoneWarmupUntimed: Upload stopped before a 3 s confirmed steady window (still in warm-up), so it has no value.
stoppedEarly.uploadPartial: Upload stopped at {at}; in-flight requests were aborted, and the {n} requests confirmed by {end} give the partial value.
stoppedEarly.uploadPartialUntimed: Upload stopped; in-flight requests were aborted, and the {n} confirmed requests give the partial value.
stoppedEarly.latency: Stopped after {pings} of {count} pings. The first is a warm-up sample, so idle latency and jitter come from the other {other}.
stoppedEarly.latencyNotRun: Stopped after {pings} of {count} pings. The first is a warm-up sample, so idle latency and jitter come from the other {other}; {phases} did not run.

serverRestarted.title: Server restarted
serverRestarted.body: The server restarted during the test, so the phase that was running reports nothing.

serverUnreachable.title: Server unreachable
serverUnreachable.body: The server stopped answering during the test.

proxyBufferingSuspected.title: Upload buffering suspected
proxyBufferingSuspected.body: Upload requests finished much later than the server read them, which suggests a proxy or the browser buffers request bodies.

browserUploadLimit.title: {browser} may limit the upload
browserUploadLimit.body: On fast links {browser}'s own upload path, not the network, can bound the upload number; the measurement is the server's and stands. Compare with another browser on this device to tell the two apart.

uploadInterrupted.title: Upload interrupted by a failed request
uploadInterrupted.body: Over HTTP/1.1 one failed request ends the upload, so its number covers the window up to the failure. HTTP/2 at the proxy lets uploads survive transient failures.

responseCompressionDetected.title: Response compression detected
responseCompressionDetected.body: Something on the path compressed the test data, so download numbers may not reflect the link.

overheadCompensation.title: Overhead compensation +{percent}
overheadCompensation.body: Rates include a +{percent} allowance for protocol overhead.

timerThrottlingDetected.title: Timer throttling detected
timerThrottlingDetected.body: The browser delayed the test's timers while the page was visible, for example in a power-saving mode. Keep the screen on during tests.

pageHidden.title: Page was hidden during the test
pageHidden.body: The browser kept the test running while the page was hidden.

networkChanged.title: Network changed
networkChanged.body: The network changed during the test; the completed phases are kept.

websocketReopened.title: WebSocket reopened
websocketReopened.body: The latency connection closed during the test and was opened again.

websocketUnavailable.title: WebSocket unavailable — HTTP latency fallback
websocketUnavailable.body: The server or a reverse proxy did not accept a WebSocket, so latency is measured with HTTP requests. Other tabs on this address may be using the server's 4 WebSocket connections.
websocketUnavailable.closed: The WebSocket closed after idle latency, so latency under load is measured with HTTP requests; the change vs idle compares the two paths.

probeReservation.title: HTTP/1.1 probe reservation active — {n} streams
probeReservation.body: One HTTP/1.1 connection is kept free for the latency probe, so throughput uses at most {n} streams.

basePathMismatch.title: Base path mismatch
basePathMismatch.body: The server is configured for another base path than this page.
